steering_ledger.verbatim: large open-source repos have all sorts of commitment inertia. We can afford to be much mroe nimble
steering_ledger.note:
GENERALISES steering #6 from three items into a REASONING RULE, and it invalidates a specific inference I made repeatedly this session. UPSTREAM MERGE STATUS ENCODES THE UPSTREAM'S CONSTRAINTS, NOT THE IDEA'S VALUE TO US. A large OSS project carries review bandwidth limits, one-change-per-PR and no-multi-backend-changes rules, CI-testability requirements, cross-platform obligations to users we do not have, and a maintenance burden spread over every consumer. We are one operator with a dedicated llama.cpp-experimental branch and a versioning discipline that already expects to carry local work forward. So a design rejected UPSTREAM ON PROCESS GROUNDS may be straightforwardly adoptable HERE.

THE CONCRETE CASE THIS BREAKS, and it is mine: intake-1191 records that the llama.cpp MoE expert-cache family is unmerged, and I drew from that a posture of 'do not port a fork'. But the dive's own evidence shows the rejections were PROCESS-LEVEL, NOT TECHNICAL - the parent PR was closed in ten minutes as too large to review, a successor was closed for violating one-change-per-PR and no-multi-backend-changes, and NO core maintainer engaged on the design across 21 comments in two months. That is textbook commitment inertia, not a negative technical verdict. The 'nothing has landed' finding remains TRUE AS A FACT ABOUT INHERITANCE (we will not get it free at the next version bump) but must stop being used as an argument against adopting it ourselves.

WHAT THIS DOES **NOT** CHANGE, so the rule is not over-applied: (a) HARDWARE facts - CUDA-only is still CUDA-only, and the compute-capability gate is still vacuous on AMD; (b) MEASUREMENT grade - an unlocated single-user anecdote is still an anecdote under MEASUREMENT.md; (c) the FROZEN-KERNEL rule - production-consolidated-v9 is never patched in place, all such work goes to llama.cpp-experimental and is promoted as a NEW version; (d) real porting COST, which must still be stated honestly (the moe-cache port is six files plus tests, not a cherry-pick).

PLAN CONSEQUENCE: every decline or posture in this batch that reasons from 'unmerged upstream' must be re-examined before the Stage-3 plan is written - specifically intake-1191's inherit-vs-port posture, intake-1185's trial recommendation, and the Stage-2b entries for the SGLang RFC cluster now in flight.
